exposure: Middle Cerebral Artery Peak Systolic Velocity (MCA-PSV)
cohort: 26 Rh-negative pregnant women with positive Indirect Coomb's tests and their non-hydropic fetuses were included.
finding: Doppler ultrasound of the middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV) demonstrated high sensitivity (88.9%) and specificity (100%) as an effective non-invasive screening method for foetal anaemia in cases of Rh alloimmunization.
